commands.description:

Edit or create an image with FLUX.1 Kontext [max]
Submits an image creation task with FLUX.1 Kontext [max]. For image editing, prefer FLUX.2 [pro] (/flux-2-pro) or FLUX.2 [flex] (/flux-2-flex) which are the recommended default models for editing workflows.

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output format for the generated image. Can be 'jpeg', 'png', or 'webp'.

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Text prompt for image generation.

options.name: --input-image
options.description: Base64 encoded image or URL to use with Kontext.

options.name: --input-image-2
options.description: Base64 encoded image or URL to use with Kontext. *Experimental Multiref*

options.name: --input-image-3
options.description: Base64 encoded image or URL to use with Kontext. *Experimental Multiref*

options.name: --input-image-4
options.description: Base64 encoded image or URL to use with Kontext. *Experimental Multiref*

options.name: --seed
options.description: Optional seed for reproducibility.

options.name: --aspect-ratio
options.description: Aspect ratio of the image between 21:9 and 9:21

options.name: --webhook-url
options.description: URL to receive webhook notifications

options.name: --webhook-secret
options.description: Optional secret for webhook signature verification

options.name: --prompt-upsampling
options.description: Whether to perform upsampling on the prompt. If active, automatically modifies the prompt for more creative generation. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --safety-tolerance
options.description: Tolerance level for input and output moderation. Between 0 and 6, 0 being most strict, 6 being least strict.

options.name: --input
options.description: Load request JSON from a file path, '-' for stdin, or an inline JSON object/array string.

options.name: --request-json
options.description: Request body as JSON.

options.name: --request-file
options.description: Path to a JSON request file, or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: generate-flux-tools-erase-v1-v1-flux-tools-erase-v1-post
commands.description:
Erase an object from an image
Submits an erase task using an input image and a mask identifying the object or region to remove.

options.name: --image
options.description: Base64-encoded input image or HTTP(S) image URL.

options.name: --mask
options.description: Base64-encoded black/white mask or HTTP(S) image URL. White pixels indicate the object to remove; black pixels are preserved. Must have the same dimensions as the input image.

options.name: --dilate-pixels
options.description: Number of pixels to dilate the mask by before removal. Dilation helps cover object edges. Maximum is 25 pixels.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Optional seed for reproducibility.

options.name: --safety-tolerance
options.description: Tolerance level for input and output moderation. Between 0 and 5, 0 being most strict, 5 being least strict.

commands.name: generate-flux-tools-outpainting-v1-v1-flux-tools-outpainting-v1-post
commands.description:
Outpaint or extend an image
Submits an outpainting task. The input image is placed on a (width, height) canvas at the given offset, and the surrounding region is generated by a FLUX outpainting model.

options.name: --input-image
options.description: Base64-encoded input (reference) image or HTTP(S) image URL.

options.name: --width
options.description: Target output width.

options.name: --height
options.description: Target output height.

options.name: --auto-crop
options.description: If True, crop the input image to the canvas bounds when it extends beyond the edges. If False, an error is raised instead. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --safety-tolerance
options.description: Tolerance level for input and output moderation. Between 0 and 5, 0 being most strict, 5 being least strict. If you wish to increase the safety_tolerance beyond these levels please reach out to the team.

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Experimental: optional text guidance for the outpainted region. The model may not strictly follow this prompt; the visual content of the input image is the primary signal. Leave unset for default behavior.

options.name: --reference-offset-x
options.description: Left offset (px) of the reference image's top-left corner on the output canvas. Negative values are allowed. None = center horizontally.

options.name: --reference-offset-y
options.description: Top offset (px) of the reference image's top-left corner on the output canvas. Negative values are allowed. None = center vertically.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Quality/speed trade-off. 'high' (default): highest-fidelity results, recommended whenever fine detail, prompt adherence, or consistency with complex content in the source image matters; slower. 'fast': significantly faster and well-suited for naturally extending most scenes (landscapes, backgrounds, textures, products); may produce lower fidelity in the extended region than 'high'.

options.name: --input
options.description: Load request JSON from a file path, '-' for stdin, or an inline JSON object/array string.

options.name: --request-json
options.description: Request body as JSON.

options.name: --request-file
options.description: Path to a JSON request file, or '-' for stdin.
